rules.rationale: This is the empty-sequence base equation for the mathematical countUpperEven summary; it defines the summary value and does not model or replace program execution.

This guarded recurrence defines countUpperEven on a nonempty code sequence by counting its head and recurring on the suffix after two positions; its simplification attribute changes evaluation behavior but it remains a summary definition rather than an extra mathematical fact.

This simplification rule supplies integer-addition associativity as an additional mathematical normalization fact. Stage 1 prove.sh compiles the rule into VERIFICATION before every kprove invocation and contains no prior rule-free proof of the exact rule, so it is trusted rather than separately proved.
